description: In 2005, Portsmouth Naval Shipyard was on the closure list. Senator Susan Collins worked alongside shipyard employees and members of the Maine and New Hampshire congressional delegations to make the case for keeping the Kittery yard open. More than two decades later, the shipyard remains vital to both our national defense and our local economy. As Chairman of […]
